reason: https://github.com/SubmitGame/.github is the SubmitGame game-catalog and organization-profile repository, not an actual game. Its GitHub API description is 'Public game catalog and SubmitGame organization profile' (https://api.github.com/repos/SubmitGame/.github), its root contents are catalog infrastructure (.agents, .github/workflows, assets, games/, ideas, profile/, scripts, svg, variants, wiki, AGENTS.md, prompt.md) with no playable game, and its rendered page (https://github.com/SubmitGame/.github) shows a 'Game catalog' index, screenshot gallery, and Games list rather than a single game's gameplay, controls, or play URL.
